desc:
Build a ten-man team from basketball history and try to go 82-0.

Spin an era and a team, then pick your players from any season of that team in that decade. Fill five starters and a bench, play a full 82-game season, then make your run through the playoffs.

VERSUS
After every season you keep one player. Ten keepers unlock versus, where you take your best ten against anyone in the server or the CPU. Put Rep on the line, win best-of-seven series and climb the leaderboard.

CHASE THE RARE ONES
Cards go from Bronze up to Dark Matter. On top of that sit 20 Icons: legendary moments that only turn up in their own era and team.

ALSO
Higher or Lower: guess who scored more and build the longest streak
A daily wheel and three daily challenges
Rewards just for playing longer each day

Join Gunkmech Games for a starter bundle and extra luck. Report bugs on group wall.
